About this item

  • Safer & Cleaner Indoor Candle Warmer Lamp: Hong-in flameless candle lamp melts wax from top down via bulb heat with zero flame, smoke or soot for clean fragrance release. A perfect home decor pick for apartments & dorms, it delivers pollution-free aromatherapy while eliminating open-flame fire risks, making it an ideal safe choice for households with kids and pets
  • 3-Speed Timing Auto Shutoff Design: This candle warmer lamp with timer supports 3 practical timing modes (2/4/8 hours). Built-in auto shutoff prevents accidents from forgotten power-off, letting you fall asleep or head out without worry for safe, effortless aromatherapy
  • 4-Level Dimmable Light & Heat Control: Unlike fixed-flame traditional candles, it features 4 graded brightness to adjust heat output freely. High brightness works as reading lamp for work & yoga, while dim settings create cozy bedroom decor ambiance for rest and sleep. Tunable heat modulates scent strength to avoid overpowering sudden fragrance from unstable open flames
  • Height Adjustable & Safe Stable Structure: Boasting an adjustable height range of 3.4–6 inches between base groove and glass shade, this wax warmer accommodates various sizes of scented jar candles. Built with premium wooden base and bottom anti-slip pads, it stays firmly in place during use and prevents sliding
  • Stylish House Decor Aesthetic & Thoughtful Gift: Featuring vintage minimalist styling, this candle warmer serves as charming room decor and complements diverse interior decor as a delicate household ornament. Great for personal daily stress relief & cozy home relaxation; also a thoughtful gift for moms, teachers, sisters, brides and female friends on birthdays, anniversaries, Mother's Day, Valentine's Day, Christmas, Thanksgiving, Housewarming, Graduation, Halloween, Easter and Wedding

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Useful and safe
I absolutely love this candle warmer! It is a very useful and safe alternative to burning candles because it melts the wax without using an open flame. I don’t have to worry about fire, smoke, or forgetting to blow out a candle before leaving the room, which gives me much more peace of mind. One of the best features is that it allows you to enjoy your favorite candle’s fragrance without actually burning it. This helps the candle last much longer since the wax melts evenly instead of burning away. The scent fills the room beautifully while preserving the quality of the candle. In addition to being practical, this candle warmer has a beautiful, modern design that looks great with any home décor. It adds a cozy and elegant touch to my room and doubles as a decorative lamp. The warm light creates a relaxing atmosphere, making it perfect for reading, working, or unwinding at the end of the day. The quality is excellent, and it is very easy to use. It provides enough light to brighten the room while creating a warm and inviting ambiance. Overall, this is a stylish, functional, and safe product that I highly recommend. If you love candles but want a safer, cleaner, and longer-lasting way to enjoy them, this candle warmer is definitely worth buying.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Peace of mind! No flame needed!
    Reviewed in the United States on August 4, 2026
    Color: Amber

    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I absolutely love my new candle warmer! I decided to get this out of my own fear of leaving the house with a candle on. I’m so glad I bought this!

    Long review for a candle warmer, but if you’re like me, you want all the details! This warmer comes with an extra bulb, huge plus if this ever goes out, I have an extra on hand. The bulb is very warm, so warm you can see from the photos that my entire 7oz full candle went from solid to liquid in about an hour. The arm of the warmer raises by turning the knob on the center of the arm, you can view the knob in the video. It goes down pretty low for the small candles and raises a few inches up for the larger/taller candles. I’ve included a picture of a small, medium and larger size candle for size. All fit well under the warmer.

    It also has a remote that is connected to the cord, you cannot remove this remote. The remote has buttons for changing the dimness , higher produces more light/more heat, and lower produced less light/less heat.

    The timer is the best part, I can hit that timer for 2, 4, or 8 hours. I’ve made a habit to always hit the 2 hour timer anytime I turn it on and it has saved me peace of mind when I’m rushing out of the house.

    Last, the appearance of this is just so pretty. The glass lamp shade, the brass/goldish arm, and the wooded base just makes this piece feel like great quality! Price can’t be beat either! Can’t go wrong with this candle warmer!

    Long review for a candle warmer, but if you’re like me, you want all the details! This warmer comes with an extra bulb, huge plus if this ever goes out, I have an extra on hand. The bulb is very warm, so warm you can see from the photos that my entire 7oz full candle went from solid to liquid in about an hour. The arm of the warmer raises by turning the knob on the center of the arm, you can view the knob in the video. It goes down pretty low for the small candles and raises a few inches up for the larger/taller candles. I’ve included a picture of a small, medium and larger size candle for size. All fit well under the warmer.

    It also has a remote that is connected to the cord, you cannot remove this remote. The remote has buttons for changing the dimness , higher produces more light/more heat, and lower produced less light/less heat.

    The timer is the best part, I can hit that timer for 2, 4, or 8 hours. I’ve made a habit to always hit the 2 hour timer anytime I turn it on and it has saved me peace of mind when I’m rushing out of the house.

    Last, the appearance of this is just so pretty. The glass lamp shade, the brass/goldish arm, and the wooded base just makes this piece feel like great quality! Price can’t be beat either! Can’t go wrong with this candle warmer!

About this Item

  • Safer & Cleaner Indoor Candle Warmer Lamp: Hong-in flameless candle lamp melts wax from top down via bulb heat with zero flame, smoke or soot for clean fragrance release. A perfect home decor pick for apartments & dorms, it delivers pollution-free aromatherapy while eliminating open-flame fire risks, making it an ideal safe choice for households with kids and pets
  • 3-Speed Timing Auto Shutoff Design: This candle warmer lamp with timer supports 3 practical timing modes (2/4/8 hours). Built-in auto shutoff prevents accidents from forgotten power-off, letting you fall asleep or head out without worry for safe, effortless aromatherapy
  • 4-Level Dimmable Light & Heat Control: Unlike fixed-flame traditional candles, it features 4 graded brightness to adjust heat output freely. High brightness works as reading lamp for work & yoga, while dim settings create cozy bedroom decor ambiance for rest and sleep. Tunable heat modulates scent strength to avoid overpowering sudden fragrance from unstable open flames
  • Height Adjustable & Safe Stable Structure: Boasting an adjustable height range of 3.4–6 inches between base groove and glass shade, this wax warmer accommodates various sizes of scented jar candles. Built with premium wooden base and bottom anti-slip pads, it stays firmly in place during use and prevents sliding
  • Stylish House Decor Aesthetic & Thoughtful Gift: Featuring vintage minimalist styling, this candle warmer serves as charming room decor and complements diverse interior decor as a delicate household ornament. Great for personal daily stress relief & cozy home relaxation; also a thoughtful gift for moms, teachers, sisters, brides and female friends on birthdays, anniversaries, Mother's Day, Valentine's Day, Christmas, Thanksgiving, Housewarming, Graduation, Halloween, Easter and Wedding
